full_page.content:
1948, September 15
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
/ POST CARD/
Bles'd be God in His every design! How ineffable His ways and His works!
September 15th '48 - Our Lady of Sorrows.
God bless you Martha Dear Sister - you and yours.
I found Sister Mary Rosella noted on August 9th: so have made out her certificate accordingly and am herewith inclosing. I hope it will be satis- factory - glad you called my attention.
Please pardon oversight and consequent delay.
I can easily understand something of how you feel, hustling all day in the hospiral, etc. It's a great work in itself and a wonderful opportunity to prac- tice charity and of course mortification in so many ways, which brings one nearer to God and endears to the Sacred Heart. Naturally "social life" often suffers - and what is to be regretted in many cases - family life too. This latter is realy important and in every way should be supplied as far as possible. . ... .. Prayer in your and O. J.'s case, I trust has helped - and let us hope will help more than anything else under circumstances.
. Fr. Solanus.
